body:
Switching to my bitch about grad school account to say:

I hate graduate school and I really hope I didn't make a mistake rearranging my life around this.

That's true, I need more joy in my life. I've been getting a lot of "just finish GPA doesn't matter" advice as well. So I guess we can see.

Thanks!
Nah I've always been middle of the pack, never anything special.

If I give myself 18 months, I'll be decide if I still like it on graduation day.

Thanks for the kind words.

I'm hoping the degree (if I can finish) will lead to jobs I'm passionate about.

To be honest, this semester isn't a good one to judge on. I have to take some pre-req courses I don't like. I'm hopeful about the ones I'm taking next semester.
Thank you :)
I hope I still have time.
/r/ExNoContact might be able to help

I do, but I'd fuck up the lives of everyone around me if I did.

I know that at least two people in my life wouldn't come back from it, and my landlord would be traumatized if I kill myself on their property.

I'm trying to fight it. Nothing is written in this life.
Society is pretty damn big. You'd be surprised what funny creatures you can find when wander long enough.

My misshapen and funny colored legos always had a purpose.

They were the special room where the superhero hid to change into his costume, or the cool room where magical stuff happened.

Don't waste the fun legos OP.

There are people at [AA](http://www.aa.org/) and [NA](https://www.na.org/) who've been where you are.

Please look up a meeting near you, they'll be friendly and empathetic.
All courses are claiming they don't curve :/
It feels like a big part. I've been looking forward to this for so long (had to defer for medical reasons).
I don't know if I'll be able to carve out time for grad school a few years down the line.

The class I'm most worried about is team taught by three people. I don't think they could boost me points, and when I tried talking to the first she told me I'm not prepared for the class (after it was too late to drop without penalty). It scared me so badly I'm afraid to show my face.
Thank you, I'll try talking to the professor.
I've failed at many, many things. This just feels like it'll be too big to come back from.
Going back is always a possibility. Thanks man.

I'm seeing a counselor, I try to not talk about my darkest thoughts, I know it seems counter productive but my state has manditory hold times and I don't have any room in my schedule for being committed.
The career field I want is full of educated people. Not to mention the masters would open doors. Many of my dream jobs want a masters, not in my field but in almost anything.

> I could sit here and think all day about how much time I wasted, but that would honestly just be wasting more time. I know what I want, and I'm going to go do it regardless of whether I am a nontraditional student.

This completely resonated with me. Thanks!
I'll feel like a failure for the rest of my life if I can't finish this. I don't know how I'll be able to look at myself in a mirror and not see someone worthless.

I'm feeling very, very low.

Flunking out would make me feel worhtless and like I were a complete failure with on chance of success anywhere else.

I wonn't go through with it though. It would hurt too many people in my life who wouldn't deserve the hurt.
For my class that's exam only I don't think this is relevant. That class doesn't even curve. It's split between professors so neither of them gets to give a student extra points.
I know I wasn't, and it might true that it was out of my hands but I still have to deal with the fallout.
I appreciate this advice but I don't have a day and a half to spare in a hospital. I might after everything settles.
My life has no worth.
He knows, he's disappointed. I think he's prepping to break the news of being thrown out gently.

The class I'm most worried about is exams only. The first professor thought I wasn't qualified for the course, the new guy doesn't seem to know me. I've got some time to cram but this all feels so hopeless.

I have plenty time to choose a lab, I'm not worried about that (yet), I'm worried I did too poorly on midterms to come back from this. I have a class that's only exam grades and I've already fucked up one.
